item.text: {"paper_id":"paper060","profile_id":"oncology","relevance":3,"evidence_quote":"Thermosensitive liposomal (TSL) drug delivery with intravascular release under hyperthermia is a promising approach for chemotherapy of solid tumors, where the hyperthermia schedule strongly influences delivery efficacy.","rationale":"The study directly addresses cancer treatment by modeling how hyperthermia schedules optimize doxorubicin delivery to solid tumors, including differences across cancer types and multidrug resistance levels.","scope_ambiguous":false,"ambiguity_note":""}
